storyline.label: DeepSeek Pro
storyline.latest_title: DeepSeek V4 Pro Leaves Preview With Agent Gains - Technology Org

prior_narrative.tldr: DeepSeek's retrained V4-Flash overtook the company's own flagship V4 Pro on nine agent benchmarks in late July. A refreshed "V4 Pro 0813" build then quietly appeared on OpenRouter with no official announcement, and an early hands-on called its multimodal quality solid.
prior_narrative.whats_new: DeepSeek has now officially confirmed the V4 Pro release — Reuters and other outlets report the Aug 12 OpenRouter build as a deliberate expansion move, not an unannounced side release.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: The confirmation closes the gap between DeepSeek's unannounced API drops and its public messaging, but the agent-benchmark question from July's Flash-beats-Pro result is still untested against this build — pin the exact release date, not just "V4 Pro," until DeepSeek ships a changelog.

status.detail: DeepSeek confirmed the V4 Pro 0813 build as an official release two days after it appeared unannounced on OpenRouter.

beats.headline: Retrained V4-Flash beats flagship V4 Pro on nine agent benchmarks
beats.summary: DeepSeek's cheaper Flash variant overtakes the company's own Pro model on agent-focused evaluations.

beats.headline: A new "V4 Pro 0813" build appears on OpenRouter with no announcement
beats.summary: Simon Willison spots the refreshed Pro model listed API-only, with no DeepSeek announcement page to explain what changed.

beats.headline: Early hands-on says the refreshed Pro's multimodal capabilities meet expectations
beats.summary: The first outside impression of the new build focuses on multimodal quality rather than the agent-benchmark gap Flash had opened.

beats.headline: DeepSeek officially confirms the V4 Pro release
beats.summary: Outlets report the Aug 12 OpenRouter build as a deliberate, confirmed expansion release rather than a quiet leak.

open_questions: Does the refreshed Pro build reclaim the agent-benchmark lead V4-Flash took in July, or does Flash remain the stronger agent option?
Does DeepSeek publish a technical changelog for V4 Pro 0813 beyond the multimodal-capability claim?
prior_narrative.take_for_builders: Re-run your agent benchmark against the now-officially-confirmed V4 Pro 0813 build rather than trusting July's Flash-beats-Pro result to still hold, and watch for the changelog DeepSeek still hasn't published.
